verses.1: Pavlos, the servant of Christ Jesus, and Timotheus, his brother Philémon, who was our beloved and trusted companion.
verses.2: And to Apheta, my sister; and to Archippus, our soldier; and to your household as well.
verses.3: May grace and peace be with you from our God, our Father, and from Jesus Christ.
verses.4: I thank my God always for making your memory eternal in my prayers.
verses.5: Hearing your love and faith that you have for the Lord Jesus, and for all the saints.
verses.6: So that the community of your faith can become active, through a recognition of all the goodness that exists in us through Christ.
verses.7: For you have brought great joy, and also an invitation to love you more deeply. For it is because of you that the wounds of the saints can be healed, brother.
verses.8: Therefore, having much participation in Christ, I command you to accept this gift.
verses.9: I beg you more out of love. After all, he is like Paul, a elderly man who is now also bound to Christ Jesus.
verses.10: I ask you regarding my son, whom I gave birth to in the bonds of marriage.
verses.11: This is never suitable for you now, but it is suitable for both you and me.
verses.12: Whoever sent you this to you, those are my complaints.
verses.13: What I intended to do was to keep him with me, so that he could serve me in the bonds of the gospel.
verses.14: But, according to the wisdom of the situation, I did not want to do anything that would prevent you from doing what is right, rather than doing what is necessary.
verses.15: For this reason, I have been forced to delay it indefinitely.
verses.16: No longer as a slave, but instead as a servant, a beloved brother, especially to me. How much more so to you, both in body and in spirit.
verses.17: If you have him with you, then hire him as my employee.
verses.18: If he has done anything unjust to you or owes you anything, then that is my problem.
verses.19: I, Paul, have written this with my own hand. I do this so that I won’t have to tell you that you owe me something as well.
verses.20: Oh, brother, I have prayed to You for help. Please heal my wounds in Christ.
verses.21: I write to you in the hope that you will keep your promise. You know that you must do as I say.
verses.22: And also, please prepare me for a journey. I hope that through your prayers, I will be able to bring some joy to you.
verses.23: May you be blessed in Epaphras, my fellow believer in Jesus Christ.
verses.24: Morkos, Aristarchus, Demas, Lukas, my colleagues.
verses.25: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, along with the Holy Spirit.
